name: BanglaLPR V3 (V2 engine + plate-image records)

detector.why: kept from V1: on val it finds more plates (96.35 %) than any V2-paper detector alone (94.94-96.35 %)

retry_why: only when V1's detector finds nothing: the paper #6 YOLOv8s, then the same on a CLAHE-enhanced copy (paper #35 low-light study: enhance only on a miss); best of 14 detector strategies on val: 97.18 % plates found, 3 photos missed (V1: 96.35 %, 9)
evaluation_protocol: paper #23: leakage-free grouped split (no plate in two splits), every choice on val, test touched once; paper #19: status from reader agreement (beat the legibility classifier as a gate)
chosen_on: OCR val (766 crops) over 2,000+ reader combinations x rules; detection val (896 photos) over 30 detector strategies
v3_changes: Same recognition engine and weights as V2 (no new training, same accuracy). V3 adds: every plate is saved as a plate image in records/plate_images/ and a row in records/plates.csv that names the image; one-click export of CSV + plate images + an HTML sheet with the pictures; a new, simpler web app (app/server.py).

night_mode.why: chosen on val by tools/night_mode_eval.py (22 Nov 2026): all five readers on the crop + on a CLAHE copy, MV-BM+format; status from the five crop readings only. Val night crops 82.61 -> 86.96 %, test night 84.62 -> 86.15 % (1 vs 0 plates, p = 1.0), whole night photos 83.33 -> 83.33 %; about 3x the reading time. Lower detector confidence found no more night plates on val (79/80 at 0.25/0.15/0.10).
night_mode.switched_by: the app: Auto (18:00-06:00 device clock) / On / Off; image brightness alone separates night poorly (results/NIGHT_MODE_RESULTS.md)
